stories.title: Define Provider Detail Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define the response schema for provider detail including NPI credentials, demographics, and structured external research links (NPI, Healthgrades, state boards).

stories.title: Implement NPI Registry Lookup Logic
stories.description: Implement core service logic to query CMS NPI Registry API, parse provider credentials, and normalize fields for downstream use.

stories.title: Generate and Validate External Research Links
stories.description: Construct standardized external research URLs including NPI profile, Healthgrades, and supported state medical boards (DE, MS, VA), and validate all generated links using the URL guardian service before returning.

stories.title: Expose Provider Detail via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate provider detail lookup into evaluate_care_facade and expose as a callable tool endpoint for the chat system.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Provider Detail Lookup
stories.description: Create tests covering NPI lookup, credential parsing, link generation, URL validation, and end-to-end facade integration.
